entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you finding it's a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, it's just... confusing. The whole interface is hard to use. I expected more for the price.
I understand. Did you get a chance to look at the quick-start guide or the online user manual?
I tried the user manual. It didn't make it any less complicated. Look, can I return it or not?
Of course. Let me just check the delivery date to confirm eligibility. One moment... Okay, I see it was delivered to you 34 days ago.
Yes, you're all set. Our return policy covers items for 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can start that return process for you right now.
Okay, good. Send me the label.

I've just sent a return authorization email to the address on file. It includes a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the device back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
Got it. When do I get my money back?

Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. That typically takes 3 to 5 business days after we receive it. Was there anything else I could help you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
